newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: World Bank's IFC lends to Mauritanian trade bank.
newsitem.headline: World Bank's IFC lends to Mauritanian trade bank.

text.p: The International Finance Corporation (IFC), the World Bank arm for financing private sector projects, said it had given a credit line of up to $14 million to Mauritania's Banque Mauritanienne pour le Commerce International (BMCI).
BMCI concentrates on trade finance, and the credit line will enable it to provide longer-term financing for export-oriented Mauritanian companies.

The IFC said this was its first investment in the finance sector in Mauritania. It has previously invested over $15 million in four small- and medium-size firms in the agribusiness, mining and fishing sectors.
